title: This repo only — sevel/experimentations
where: <repo>/.claude/skills/  ·  same procedures as their /lab: twins, with this repo's tracks, units and AGP upstream built in
rows: Sourced report under <track>/explorations/, scoped to SRAM, bytes moved, euros, lap time.
Challenge a choice against grams, euros, milliseconds, kilobytes, joules, lap seconds.
Entry in the right docs/decisions.md; checks whether it also belongs in ../AGP.
Recap of a track's state: roadmap, open decisions, live hypotheses H1, H2, H3.
note: Inside this repo these take priority over the /lab: versions.

title: Code quality — bundled
rows: Review the current diff or a PR for correctness bugs. Levels low to max; ultra runs a multi-agent cloud review (billed). --fix applies findings, --comment posts them on the PR.
Review changed code for reuse, simplification and efficiency, then apply the fixes. Quality only, not bug-hunting.
Security review of the pending changes on the current branch (code vulnerabilities; for data leakage use /lab:integrity-audit).
Launch and drive the project's app to see a change actually working, not just the tests.
Create a CLAUDE.md documenting the codebase (different from /lab:init, which writes the lab profile).

title: Automation and setup — bundled
rows: Repeat a prompt or command on an interval, or self-paced if no interval is given.
Create, list, update or run scheduled cloud agents on a cron schedule, or a one-off run at a set time.
Change settings.json: hooks (whenever X, do Y), permissions, environment variables.
Scan past sessions for safe read-only commands and add an allowlist so you are asked less often.
Reference for building with the Claude API and SDK: model ids, pricing, tool use, caching, agents.
Drive your Chrome browser: click, fill forms, screenshot, read console logs.

title: Design, charts and published pages — bundled
where: mostly used by Claude on its own when the task calls for it
rows: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building or reshaping a UI.
Read before making any chart or dashboard: form heuristics, a validated colour system, light and dark.
Design fundamentals for Artifacts (hosted web pages on claude.ai); loaded before writing one.
When a diagram earns its place, and how to draw one that stays legible in both themes.
What a published page can do at runtime: live data, shared state, saved input, files.

title: Documents — synced from your claude.ai account
where: ~/.claude/skills/synced/  ·  typed as /anthropic-skills:<name>, or just ask in plain words
rows: Living documents people share, comment on and edit together.
Create, read and edit Word documents, including tracked changes and templates.
Create, read and edit PowerPoint decks.
Create, clean and edit spreadsheets, including CSV and TSV.
Read, merge, split, fill, OCR and create PDFs.
Create and improve skills, and measure them with evals: the tool for testing the lab skills properly.
Your morning brief as a styled page, or set it up as a recurring weekday task.
Import a memory export from another AI assistant into Claude's memory.

title: Session commands — not skills, but worth knowing
where: built into the Claude Code terminal
rows: The live list of every skill in this session; switch individual ones on or off.
Pick up a newly added plugin or plugin skill without restarting. Fixes Unknown command: /lab:...
What Claude may do without asking.
Choose the model, settings, toggle faster output.
Give the session another directory; move it to one.
List the pages you have published; open or copy a link.
Start the conversation over; everything else.
